status: Post-comparison numerical diagnostic; original frozen protocol and comparison-result.json unchanged
reason: The pinned SNooPy default Simpson rule on irregular stellar wavelength grids differs from union-grid trapezoid by 0.00014 to 0.00387 mag across the seven bands, larger than published MAGREF precision. Check numerical integration of the same fixed piecewise-linear tabulated spectra and filters without altering any source choice or fitting offsets.

The integrand is cubic within each interval; this is exact for the piecewise-linear input convention. Report differences versus frozen Simpson and union-grid trapezoid, and versus published MAGREF solely as a diagnostic; no replacement of the preregistered primary comparison or reinterpretation of origin.
inputs: Exactly the seven spectra/filter mappings and hashes in comparison-protocol.json; no new source version
